annotation.summary_en: For the Ren-born counterexample, Wu Qu Hua Ji shares the Life Palace with Qing Yang. The author says Tian Fu no longer generates Wu Qu beneficially, discussing adverse temperament, relationships, health and wealth while explicitly rejecting an automatic prediction of early death. Wealth stars favor Wealth and Property Palaces, but benefic and malefic conditions still govern interpretation.

annotation.summary_en: Lu Ma Jiao Chi is not inherently favorable: palace strength and benefic or malefic conditions matter, while foreign place is interpreted broadly as outward engagement. The ancient quotation concerns Lu Ma in strong Life/Body or major-period palaces. The author names Yin, Shen, Si and Hai the four growth or horse locations and states a year-stem polarity rule for Tian Ma placement; that claim is retained as the source’s account.

annotation.summary_en: The four horse locations have no effect by themselves; occupied stars are described as more active. Sha Po Lang are classed as active, Zi Wei and Tian Fu as quiet. Holding other stars aside, Tian Fu in Si is compared with You, and Qi Sha in Yin with Xu. The discussion extends Wu Qu’s Lu Ma Jiao Chi outward symbolism and cites teaching delivered in late 1995.

scope.attribution: 紫雲《斗數星曜賦性》第二冊作者论述；古引依原文另标
scope.condition: 若在不考慮其他星曜的影響之下，天府在巳坐命者的個性就比天府在酉坐命者來得活潑些。同理，原來主「動」的星曜進入四馬之地後，就會動得更厲害。例如，七殺在寅坐命者，做起事來的衝勁，就比七殺在戌坐命者來得強些。
